human_reference: Official original Eval near TextGrids, paired by full headset stem; generic c1 tier identity replaced only by the source filename's explicit SPK identity.

initial_model_rejected.result: Rejected and its initial preparation process cancelled. No unknown-token duration spreading, transcript deletion or substitute words accepted.

selected_model.api: Qwen3ForcedAligner.align, supplied human transcript, language Chinese, CPU float32
selected_model.unit_policy: Every original lexical character is a requested timestamp unit; whitespace is added only in the aligner's input view so Latin abbreviations also receive model predictions rather than duration division. Original lexical text and punctuation are retained separately.
selected_model.interpolation_policy: The upstream aligner processor's fix_timestamp repair is disabled on this local instance. Raw model timestamp predictions are used. Reversed/nonfinite/out-of-range predictions fail preparation; no interpolation or sentence-duration spreading is permitted.
selected_model.word_policy: jieba 0.42.1 with HMM disabled groups the unchanged original characters. Word extent is the extent of their raw character predictions, not equal subdivision.
selected_model.uncertainty: Automatic timing only. Raw zero-length/overlapping estimates are not manually corrected or portrayed as human timing. Inter-character gaps are model-estimated candidates, not listening-confirmed pauses.

rejected_primary_prediction_policy: Invalid reversed/out-of-clip Qwen predictions are retained as failure evidence. Only those segments receive a second, genuine monotone CTC forced alignment against the exact original lexical characters, choosing a pinned model whose vocabulary covers every character. Chinese fillers use wbbbbb/wav2vec2-large-chinese-zh-cn at b654b5f3df69725df32808de454a1b865c829e4c; Latin-capable segments may use jonatasgrosman at the pinned revision above. Missing or randomly initialized weights are rejected. There is no interpolation, substitute transcript, lexical deletion, or sentence-duration spreading.
punctuation_policy: Retain every original punctuation mark. Append a terminal Chinese full stop only to a source segment lacking terminal punctuation, without changing lexical characters. Such restored boundaries are rule-based and uncertain, not human-reannotated sentence judgments.
turn_policy: Source human speaker-label changes in onset-ordered intervals; simultaneous labels retain overlapping playback fragments. No automatic diarization is substituted.
general_stress_separation: General uses fixed-seed eligible candidate selection. Stress uses a separate deterministic ranking of text-pattern candidates (short acknowledgements, final particles/fillers, multiple terminal-punctuation marks); forced-aligned internal gaps are counted separately with automatic-reference uncertainty. Neither is a representative overall-ranking mixture.
